changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE krrg_employee_profile_projects ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, profile_id BIGINT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT, progress TEXT, organisation_id BIGINT, role VARCHAR(255), start_at DATE, end_at DATE, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT fk_employee_profile_projects__profile FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES krrg_employee_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_employee_profile_projects__organisation FOREIGN KEY (organisation_id) REFERENCES krrg_organisations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_employee_profile_projects__profile_id ON krrg_employee_profile_projects (profile_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_employee_profile_projects__organisation_id ON krrg_employee_profile_projects (organisation_id);

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE krrg_employee_profile_project_skills ( project_id BIGINT NOT NULL, skill_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_employee_profile_project_skills PRIMARY KEY (project_id, skill_id), CONSTRAINT fk_employee_profile_project_skills__project FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES krrg_employee_profile_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_employee_profile_project_skills__skill FOREIGN KEY (skill_id) REFERENCES krrg_employee_skill(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_employee_profile_project_skills__skill_id ON krrg_employee_profile_project_skills (skill_id);
